user_input: Who was Ariadne in Greek mythology?
model_output:
Ariadne was a character in Greek mythology, known for her role in the myth of the Minotaur. She was the daughter of King Minos of Crete and his wife, Pasiphaë. According to the myth, Ariadne helped Theseus, the Athenian hero, to defeat the Minotaur by giving him a ball of string, which he used to navigate his way through the labyrinth where the monster lived.

After Theseus killed the Minotaur, Ariadne fled to the island of Naxos, where she was abandoned by Theseus. She was later married to the god Dionysus, and some versions of the myth say that she was placed among the stars as the constellation Corona.

Ariadne was also known as a goddess of wisdom and was often depicted holding a ball of thread, symbolizing her role in the myth of the Minotaur.
